# Asolaria computational light-bank evidence — archival v0.2 publication index
**Record updated 2026-10-15 · public computational evidence index · v0.2 package ready; Hugging Face upload pending**

This is a separate **publication index**, not a peer-certified scientific article or an independently verified photonic-memory device. Multiple source computational experiment PRs have since been integrated into `main` with distinct exact-head CI and full preserved histories; this index does NOT itself merge their data or approve physical claims. It records the existing archived outputs and their frozen digests, plus a new upload-ready dataset bundle prepared for [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets). The bundle is available to the repository owner for upload; no public HF dataset is claimed to exist until a true remote upload/readback is completed.

## Newly archived independent scientific peers — v0.2

Two new cross-platform reviewers are included in the updated 59-file dataset, not blended into the older producer results.

- **Seat 2 independent provenance review [merged PR #77](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/pull/77)**: [CI #38741832217](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/actions/runs/38741832217) **2/2 PASS**; 32/32 actual saved QR image-plane reads with independently implemented ZXing-C++; 65,536 original bytes restored; all 52,488 digital case verdicts independently reviewed. OpenCV 4.13 recovered **15/32** QR images at this published size, a recorded interoperability limitation. An additional 34,992 independent software attack packets were rejected (these are **not** additional original experiment rows); 8,748 legitimate packets accepted. Scientific receipt 6,444 B SHA `eeefd8e355788e762f18744604ac2635464cf80a1f197bee92261071d2c38c46` identical Ubuntu/Windows; runner-repacked ZIP metadata SHA differences separately retained. Local self-consistency of SHA is **not external source authentication**.
- **Seat 3 independent mathematics review [merged PR #76](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/pull/76)**: [CI #38741669991](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/actions/runs/38741669991) **4/4 PASS**, independently regenerated exact 52,488-row, 10,773,162-byte case HBP SHA `dca7e5e2b14ada4e28f7ebeb96adef528c28ae6e169a1e21ee8ba058c6836a09`, 2,187 routes, and 10,000 conserved synthetic trades. **Mathematical falsifier:** intensity-only `(S²,Q,Q)` cannot preserve ordered colour: all permutations of RGB map to equal intensities. Exactly 27 unique ordered ternary addresses become only **10 unnormalized intensity signatures**.
- **New author-calculated extension, not separately peer-reviewed:** after normalizing these signatures, the 27 addresses collapse into **7 classes including the undefined all-zero case**, and conditional colour-address uncertainty is ~2.149596 bits (compared with ~1.631078 bits for unnormalized signatures). Pure Python exact-fraction verifier bundled in `scripts/verify_rainbow27_information_loss.py`. The ordered logical sector identity is `9r+3g+b` and should be preserved separately where needed; this is *not* 27 experimentally measured optical wavelengths.

This v0.2 package contains both peer seats' original CI ZIPs and actual scientific HBP receipts, plus a separate addendum preserving reviewer objections and negative evidence. It is an archived **computational** release candidate, not verified physical light storage, calibrated biology, genuine quantum measurement or full four-seat promotion.

## Technical interpretation

- The original [Colour QR](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/the-colour-qr) is three standard indexed QR symbols placed into independently decodable R/G/B pixel channels. Its software PNG readback is **not** optical-material storage.
- The separate [Light Boat](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/light-boat-engine-ships-with-oils) transmit/absorb/reflect `T+A+R=1` is a classical outcome/closure model, **not** the same 3 channels as the Colour QR or a measured photon memory.
- The projector `P=I-J/3` from the [August space/light/colour source](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/the-law-of-space-and-light-and-color-and-travel-at-the-speed-of-one) discards the shared RGB mode. Exact recovery needs a retained sideband.
- The new A/B/P digital XOR parity is a two-of-three **erasure recovery**, not authentication, secrecy or an original measured physical memory-stick implementation.
- The synthetic photocycle coefficients, current proxies, optical bank indices and finite control policies are chosen model assumptions, **not fitted measured ion currents, physical photons, hardware hosts, speed-of-light effects or independent biological validation**.
- Identical digest values prove byte identity to a pinned reference, not a trusted external physical source or four independent hardware witnesses.

## Publication conditions

The computational traces are real archived software outputs with uploaded GitHub Actions evidence and selected independent byte-level checks. Still outstanding: cross-seat source/provenance referee objections, *independent four-seat acceptance*, photo-to-camera robustness, physical optical memory write/read and retention, experimental optogenetic calibration, human release authority for physical or external claims. Previous failed CI/correction histories remain linked to their original PRs. **Several software experiment PRs have now merged into `main` as individually scoped classical computational components; publishing this index neither changes their result hashes nor relabels them as physical proof.**
